title: Moss and the Cool Pool
checkpoint: Reception Spring 2, week 1 — Learning — Phase 3: new sounds oa, oo, oo (book)
note_for_grown_ups: Non-fiction, Phase 3, 41-sound stage (oa, oo, short oo just added). A true fact: on a hot day, many different animals will share the same puddle or pool to drink from.

pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog standing in bright sunshine, looking warm.
Moss spotting a round stone pool of water on top of a low grey wall.
Moss the hedgehog sipping water from the stone pool, looking refreshed.

pages.text: A fox sees the pool too.
pages.illustration: A orange-red fox approaching the stone pool on the wall from the other side.
Moss the hedgehog and the fox both sipping water from the stone pool together.

pages.text: A goat sees the pool too.
pages.illustration: A white goat approaching the stone pool from the grass below.

pages.text: Moss, the fox and the goat sip.
pages.illustration: Moss, the fox and the goat all sipping water together from the stone pool.

pages.text: Lots of pals get a cool sip.
pages.illustration: Several different small animals gathered round the stone pool on the wall, all drinking together.
